中国探月与深空探测网 (CLEP)
嫦娥六号 — 中文维基百科

First sample return from the lunar far side — possibly the most scientifically significant lunar mission since Apollo. Far-side material (thicker crust, older surface, different composition) was completely unstudied. These samples may finally explain why the Moon's two hemispheres are so fundamentally different.

Sample return from a relay-only site — combines far-side relay via the Queqiao relay satellites (Queqiao-2 for Chang'e 6) with Chang'e 5's sample-return architecture. The full set of capabilities for Mars Sample Return at any latitude.

Chang'e 6 landed in the South Pole-Aitken basin on June 1, 2024 — the first sample-return mission from the far side of the Moon, the deepest, oldest, largest impact structure in the inner Solar System. Returned 1,935 g of far-side material to Earth on June 25, 2024 — samples that may contain mantle fragments from the 4.2-billion-year-old basin-forming impact.
Chang'e 5 redesign for far-side sample return
Chang'e 6 stack — added Queqiao-2 relay for far-side comms, otherwise inheriting Chang'e 5 architecture.
Long March 5 launches Chang'e 6 — 28-day round trip to the lunar far side, including 14 days waiting for the right relay-comms window.
Apollo Crater (within South Pole-Aitken) — landed June 1, 2024
